extraction.framework: React 18 SPA built with Vite 5 (no router library; hand-rolled pathname ternary switch in src/App.jsx), single index.html shell, Vercel SPA catch-all rewrite
extraction.notes: Literal hrefs and href: object entries are resolved from JSX/JS sources; JSON link keys (url, github, live, amazonLink, link) are resolved from data files; template literals are expanded only when the referenced const is a literal string in the same file.

script_access.meaning: Source values accessed, not proof of semantic understanding

limitations: Route matching is runtime pathname logic in src/App.jsx; no static route manifest, prerender or per-route metadata.
Links rendered by TextLink/anchors from JSON data are source-backed but their runtime visibility depends on React rendering.
FeaturedWork project cards are <button onClick> actions (portal dialog), not anchors; not captured as links.
ScrollReveal visibility is runtime (IntersectionObserver); links inside are still source-observed.
No production origin in source; internal hrefs are origin-relative and resolved against the page route only.
Model discovery budget reached; remaining semantic investigation is unresolved. The extractor still receives the full captured snapshot.
